W.note: Aurora-edged pill with a breathing glow layer, long-tailed 1.4s opacity glow and sparkle, strong focus ring, reduced-motion and opacity-only animation, though the hover change is modest.

X.note: Full-width gradient button gets a lovely iridescent wash on hover, but the label visibly washes out mid-transition and the blur glow plus transition:all is less disciplined.

Y.note: Pale lavender plate with halo bloom, floating drift and asymmetric slow-in, slower-out curves feels very ethereal and the label stays legible, with good focus and reduced-motion handling, but the effect is subtle.

Z.note: Gradient pill that blooms a soft halo with overshoot and an arrow reveal, clean and legible with sensible reduced-motion, but the effect is more conventional and the layout is plain.
